Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: All participants related to a patient with familial combined hyperlipidemia
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented heterozygous LDLR c.1444G>A mutation consistent with familial hypercholesterolemia (FH), not familial combined hyperlipidemia (FCHL). The inclusion criterion specifies FCHL, which is distinct from FH.

Recap: The patient does not meet the inclusion criterion due to a diagnosis of familial hypercholesterolemia instead of familial combined hyperlipidemia. No exclusion criteria were provided for evaluation.
